rationale: The workflow installs Python dependencies (pip install humanize, pip install -e .) on every scheduled run with no dependency cache. The repository has pyproject.toml and the job recurs on a daily schedule, so repeated dependency fetching is measurable and the cache input (pyproject.toml) is available. Pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads) is supported: preconditions hold (repeated dependency fetching measurable; cache inputs include the dependency manifest/environment), and no contraindication applies (no equivalent cache already exists; pip cache is not mutable/untrusted content in the prohibited sense). Add an actions/cache@v4 step for ~/.cache/pip keyed on hashFiles('pyproject.toml') before the pip install step. All build/update/deploy steps and required checks are preserved; no permissions are weakened and no new network, deployment, publishing, or privileged actions are added.
